release_notes:
RJD PisoWiFi System v3.14.17 - Portal UI Overhaul & Hardware Fixes

🎨 Dark glassmorphism portal UI — unified cards, header, modals, chat
🔧 Fixed voucher input layout — clean horizontal row with glass-style input
🛡️ Duplicate alert prevention — showError/showOfflineNotice mutually exclusive
💰 REDEEM CREDIT button — same size as INSERT COIN, renamed
📱 Mobile zero-scroll optimization — all components fit without scrolling
🔌 x64 PC no-GPIO enforced — coinPin/relayPin null, no pin displayed
🌐 VLAN strict isolation — ZeroTier/non-VLAN clients get empty coinbox list + error
